crossRefs.note: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was…
The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”
Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of…
For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which…
Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.
You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

translations.web: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”
translations.bsb: What do you think?” “He deserves to die,” they answered.
translations.kjv: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
translations.asv: what think ye? They answered and said, He is worthy of death.
